subject: ela
cluster: Range of Reading and Level of Text Complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

She gave the stranger her last meal and went hungry.

She is:
A) selfish
B) selfless
C) cruel

steps: Gave her food. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The sea roared and flung its fists against the cliffs.

This is:
A) personification
B) a fact
C) a summary

To support an interpretation of a text, use:
A) the strongest textual evidence
B) a guess
C) the cover price

Read.

The lawyer took the hopeless case no one would touch, knowing it would cost him clients and comfort.

The theme is:
A) always protect yourself
B) justice can demand personal sacrifice
C) lawyers are rich
items.answer: B) justice can demand personal sacrifice

steps: His sacrifice reveals the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) justice can demand personal sacrifice

items.prompt:
Read.

'The road was a ribbon of moonlight.'

This is a:
A) metaphor
B) summary
C) fact

steps: Road IS a ribbon. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The story leaps back to the day that broke him.

This structure is a:
A) flashback
B) cliffhanger
C) climax

Read.

The witness swears he 'saw nothing,' yet he describes the car's color, the driver's jacket, and the exact time.

The narrator/witness is best described as:
A) reliable
B) unreliable
C) omniscient

steps: His claim contradicts his details. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The king who feared betrayal betrayed everyone first, and died alone in a palace of enemies he had made.

The BEST theme is:
A) Fear and distrust can bring about the very ruin one dreads.
B) Kings should betray others.
C) Palaces are dangerous.
items.answer: A) Fear and distrust can bring about the very ruin one dreads.

steps: His end refines the theme. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Fear and distrust can bring about the very ruin one dreads.
